title: Gaussian Belief Propagation and Periodic Jacobi Matrices on Trees: Spectral Curve, Antibound Poles, and Fixed Points
abstract: arXiv:2611.29381v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diagonal Green functions of a periodic Jacobi operator on a universal covering tree satisfy the scalar Gaussian belief propagation covariance equations on the finite connected loopless base multigraph. At cycle rank at least two, the Green functions continue to simple antibound poles at both Perron values for arbitrary real potentials and nonzero real weights. This proves the conjecture of Christiansen, Simon and Zinchenko. For positive weights the pole result includes self-loops. On loopless graphs the lower pole is the walk-summability threshold. Each energy strictly between it and the spectral bottom has at least two fixed points with positive definite local beliefs. On a connected simple graph, some coefficients yield a compact component of positive solutions exactly when the graph contains two vertex-disjoint connected subgraphs of cycle rank at least two. translated_title: 树上的高斯置信传播与周期雅可比矩阵：谱曲线、反束缚极点与不动点
translated_abstract: 万有覆盖树上周期雅可比算子的对角格林函数满足有限连通无环基础多重图上的标量高斯置信传播协方差方程。当圈秩至少为二时，对于任意实势和非零实权重，格林函数在两个Perron值处均可延拓为简单的反束缚极点。这证明了Christiansen、Simon和Zinchenko的猜想。对于正权重，极点结果也适用于含自环的图。在无环图上，下极点即为游走可和性阈值。严格介于该阈值与谱底之间的每个能量至少存在两个具有正定局部信念的不动点。在连通简单图上，存在某些系数使得正解具有紧致分量，当且仅当该图包含两个顶点不交且圈秩至少为二的连通子图。协方差曲线在一般情况下是不可约的，每条边对应一个叶面……
tldr: 该论文证明了在圈秩至少为二的图上，周期雅可比算子的格林函数在两个Perron值处均可延拓为反束缚极点，从而证明了Christiansen-Simon-Zinchenko猜想，并刻画了高斯置信传播不动点的存在条件与游走可和性阈值。
en_tdlr: The paper proves that Green functions of periodic Jacobi operators on trees extend to simple antibound poles at both Perron values for graphs of cycle rank at least two, resolving the Christiansen-Simon-Zinchenko conjecture, and characterizes the existence of Gaussian belief propagation fixed points and the walk-summability threshold.
